entries.title: Six-round operating rhythm
entries.summary: Run six rounds. Each round proceeds through income, Gaia processing, player actions, and cleanup; at the end of round six, skip cleanup and move to final scoring.

entries.title: Setup is randomized, not a fixed puzzle
entries.summary: Build the player-count board, prepare research spaces, scoring tiles, round boosters, factions, resources, and starting structures. Preserve the document’s randomization steps rather than assuming a fixed tech or scoring layout.

entries.title: A mine needs both reach and an immediate payment
entries.summary: Treat a mine as legal only when the planet is empty, reachable from a colonized planet, and habitable after any required terraforming. Navigation sets the base range; QIC can extend it. The mine cost must be paid in full when the action is taken.

source_locator.locator: Actions / Build a Mine; Build a Mine action

entries.title: A Gaia project is a delayed conversion
entries.summary: Starting a Gaia project moves the required power and places a Gaiaformer, but the conversion is completed in the following round’s Gaia phase. A project begun in the final round will not finish before scoring.

entries.title: Upgrades replace one structure at a time
entries.summary: Only mines go directly onto empty planets. Other structures are upgrades that replace an existing structure and advance one step per upgrade action; pay the listed ore and credit cost at the moment of upgrade.

source_locator.locator: Actions / Upgrade Existing Structures; Upgrade action

entries.title: Separate round bonuses from final ranking
entries.summary: A round scoring tile applies for one round and is then removed. Final scoring tiles are evaluated after the six-round game, with ranking tracks and neutral-player markers affecting the comparison.
